semantic_fragments.content: Motor running overload protection test (Clause 13.2.13.3-b) applies when: (1) motor is intended to be remotely or automatically controlled by a single control device with no redundant protection, or (2) it is likely to be subjected to CONTINUOUS OPERATION while unattended. Both conditions are N/A for this equipment as it is not intended for remote/automatic control and is not for continuous unattended operation.

Clause 13.2.13.4 (NON-CONTINUOUS OPERATION) is declared N/A for this equipment because it is rated for continuous operation. The clause requires ME EQUIPMENT (other than HAND-HELD) to be operated under normal load at RATED voltage until temperature increase is 5°C in one hour or a protective device operates.

For PEMS (Clause 14), the RISK MANAGEMENT plan required by 4.2.2 must include reference to the PEMS VALIDATION plan. The PEMS DEVELOPMENT LIFE-CYCLE must document defined milestones, with each milestone specifying: activities to be completed, VERIFICATION methods, activity inputs/outputs, and RISK MANAGEMENT activities that must be completed before that milestone. The life-cycle must be tailored for specific development by plans detailing activities, milestones and schedules.
